name: set_camera_target_position

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetCameraTargetPosition consumes three coordinates, converts them to floats, stores them in the shared camera target-position vector, and rebuilds the camera through func_001C8170

notes: ScriptCommand_SetCameraTargetPosition writes the X, Y, and Z coordinates to D_003C0E30 through D_003C0E38. func_001C8170 uses that vector as the target about which it applies the configured rotation and distance. All 73 JP calls are immediately followed by command 37 set_camera_rotation_degrees and then command 38 set_camera_distance.
